children: Wasatch Advisors sold a little over half a percent stake in Medi Assist Healthcare Services, while Craft Emerging Market Fund offloaded 2.48 percent of its holding in Value 360 Communications through open market transactions on November 19.

According to bulk and block deal data published on Thursday, Wasatch Advisors Inc, through its Wasatch Emerging India Fund, sold 3.86 lakh shares, representing 0.51 percent of Medi Assist Healthcare Services' paid-up equity capital, for Rs 10.83 crore. The shares were sold at an average price of Rs 280.1 apiece.
The transaction represented a partial exit from the 3.45 percent stake held by Wasatch Emerging India Fund in the Bengaluru-headquartered company as of September 2026.
Shares of Medi Assist Healthcare Services fell 1.53 percent to Rs 279.8 on Thursday, accompanied by higher trading volumes.
Craft Emerging Market Fund offloads 2.48% stake in Value 360 Communications

Meanwhile, Craft Emerging Market Fund, through three of its schemes, sold 3.99 lakh shares, equivalent to 2.48 percent of Value 360 Communications' paid-up equity capital, for approximately Rs 3.4 crore.

Craft Emerging Market Fund PCC's Elite Capital Fund sold 99,600 shares at Rs 85.4 apiece, while its Arbitrage Strategy Fund offloaded 1.08 lakh shares at Rs 85 per share. Citadel Capital Fund sold another 1.92 lakh shares at Rs 85.02 apiece.
As of September 2026, Elite Capital Fund held a 3.46 percent stake (5.56 lakh shares) in Value 360, while Citadel Capital Fund owned 3.83 percent (6.15 lakh shares).
Shares of Value 360 Communications also came under pressure following the stake sale, falling 2.79 percent to Rs 87.1.
Quant Mutual Fund, Florida Retirement System, Optimix Wholesale Global buy 0.63% stake in Black Box
Meanwhile, Black Box also witnessed significant block deal activity on Thursday. Its shares rallied 3.11 percent to Rs 907.4, accompanied by higher trading volumes.

Quant Mutual Fund, Florida Retirement System and Optimix Wholesale Global Emerging Markets Share Trust collectively acquired 0.63 percent stake in Black Box, the Essar Group-backed global digital infrastructure and IT solutions provider, for Rs 96.86 crore.

Quant Mutual Fund purchased 3.75 lakh shares, Florida Retirement System acquired 5.6 lakh shares, and Optimix Wholesale Global Emerging Markets Share Trust picked up 2 lakh shares. Together, they acquired 11.35 lakh shares from Jainam Broking and Setu Securities at an average price of Rs 853.4 apiece.
On the selling side, Jainam Broking offloaded 3.89 lakh shares, while Setu Securities sold 7.45 lakh shares in Black Box.
According to the latest shareholding pattern, Quant Mutual Fund already held a 3.02 percent stake, equivalent to 53.69 lakh shares, in Black Box.

title: Wasatch Advisors sells 0.51% stake in Medi Assist; Craft Emerging Market Fund offloads 2.48% in Value 360
